features.zc_ssc_threshold: 0.01 x per-channel RMS of the TRAINING windows
features.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training windows only

classifiers.cnn_pretrained_ft: DB2 encoder transferred, fresh head, 600 steps, batch 128, AdamW lr 0.0003

rest_behaviour.false_activation_rate: fraction of true-rest windows predicted as a movement; exactly 1 - rest_recall
rest_behaviour.false_activations_per_min: maximal runs of movement prediction inside a true-rest stretch, per minute of rest; events, not windows, and not derivable from the rate
rest_behaviour.event_grouping: per repetition, so no event spans a seam between two

no_tuning_on_test: All classifier settings fixed a priori; no search. Normalization, feature scaler and ZC/SSC thresholds fitted on training repetitions only.
